'''Yath Endidee''' was a [[Quarren]] criminal who,<ref name="Chapter 14" /> by [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|14}}</ref> was arrested by the [[New Republic]] for attempted [[Death|murder]] and resisting arrest and was serving a 40-[[Standard year|year]] sentence on<ref name="Chapter 14" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="Guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> [[Virujansi]].<ref name="Chapter 14" /> That year,<ref name="Date" /> while in need of finding fellow [[prisoner]] [[Migs Mayfeld]] in the New Republic [[prison]] registry, the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]] traveled to<ref name="Chapter 14" /> the planet<ref name="Chapter 8">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 8: Redemption}}</ref> [[Nevarro]] and asked [[Marshal]] [[Carasynthia Dune]] to locate Mayfeld in the registry, to which Dune complied. As numerous mugshots flashed on the screen in front of Dune in<ref name="Chapter 14" /> her<ref name="Chapter 8" /> [[Cara Dune's office|office]], the profile of Endidee quickly appeared before disappearing.<ref name="Chapter 14" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yath Endidee's profile appeared in "[[Chapter 14: The Tragedy]],"<ref name="Chapter 14" /> the sixth episode of the [[The Mandalorian Season Two|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which aired on [[December 4]], [[2020]].<ref name="Companion">{{InsiderCite|202|Star Wars: The Mandalorian Season Two Companion|''Star Wars: The Mandalorian'' Season Two Companion}}</ref> The costume of Endidee is a reused costume of a [[Unidentified Quarren boatman's brother|Quarren]] which first appeared in "[[Chapter 11: The Heiress]],"<ref name="Chapter 11">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 11: The Heiress}}</ref> the third episode of the second season of ''The Mandalorian'', which aired on [[November 13]], 2020.<ref name="Companion" />
